title: Research: present-head flag 43 hosts its tail before its head (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

One-flag follow-up under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. Completes the present-head class `(0,1,9,43)` chronology outside the flag-0 coefficient cascade: [#3349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3349) names the class; [#3392](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3392) pins absent-head flag 2; [#3443](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3443) pins flag 9; [#3451](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3451) pins flag 1 with span method. This package pins flag 43 (`X21` → `Y59`, basis head `15`).

On the published 4,058-event word:

- the head enters `Y59` (listed and in GF(2) span) only at the terminal rank-3 transport after-frame at event 3525
- all 15 `Y59` adds (last at event 3364) run in head-free charts (`head_free_target_updates=15/15`); ten run in the empty chart
- `X21`'s literal drop at event 570 keeps `15` in span (`3 ^ 4 ^ 8`); `source_span_drops=0`
- **new on this flag:** updates 3231 and 3364 already span non-head basis vectors `{32}` then `{6, 18, 32}`, co-hosted with `X21`'s live rank-9 frame (`tail_cohosting_updates=2`) — endpoints share part of the flag basis while the target is still updated; only the head is missing
- `preterminal_hosting=0` and `preterminal_span_hosting=0`; zero joint endpoint events; frames unrestored

Chronological dirty restoration therefore cannot use co-hosted **basis-head** geometry on this word. Drop/arrive/gap 570/3525/2955 differs from flag 1 (591/3473/2882) and flag 9 (500/3489/2989); scanners refuse equal prior tuples.

**Scoped obstruction. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918. Coefficient delivery (flag-0 cascade on `Y34`) is outside this package; open #3363's 208-flag relay census is cited only as leave-alone context.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-present-head-flag43-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag43-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag43-audit/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag43-audit/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-present-head-flag43-audit
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG43 flag=43 head=15 preterminal_hosting=0 preterminal_span_hosting=0 drop_event=570 arrive_event=3525 source_span_drops=0 head_free_target_updates=15/15 tail_cohosting_updates=2 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG43_INDEPENDENT flag=43 head=15 preterminal_hosting=0 preterminal_span_hosting=0 drop_event=570 arrive_event=3525 source_span_drops=0 head_free_target_updates=15/15 tail_cohosting_updates=2 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG43_TESTS groups=7
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-present-head-flag43-audit outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: [#3451](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3451) (flag 1 span method), [#3443](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3443) (flag 9), [#3349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3349), [#3392](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3392), merged [#3242](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3242). Does not reopen those packages, #3441/#3436/#3421/#3411, deferred V45/rho=0, or the merged readout series through #2883. Soft-overlap checked against open #3363/#3365/#3371/#3372: this package recomputes no coefficient and says nothing about `Y34`.
